places.name: Pescăria Sutac
places.evidence: Own site + press: three-generation fisherman family (Sutac) who fish daily and run the restaurant themselves; framed everywhere as a family story, not an investor venture

places.name: Terasa Lakme
places.evidence: Google/directory reviews describe 'terasă simplă cu o familie primitoare' — family-run terrace with the family serving; no chain/investor affiliation found
